## Due This Week
* **Mon, Sep 21 @ 8:00 AM**: Online Quiz – MATH-1850U (Linear Algebra) [Mobius]
* **Mon, Sep 21 @ 8:00 AM**: Online Quiz #2 – MATH-1010U (Calculus I) [Mobius]
* **Mon, Sep 21**: Fall 2026 Student Fees Payment Deadline – Ontario Tech University
* **Thu, Sep 24 @ 6:00 PM – Fri, Sep 25 @ 11:59 PM**: Quiz 1 – ENGR-1015U (Intro to Engineering) [Canvas]

## Announcements
* **Physics I (PHY-1010U)**:
  * Tutorial Tests begin the week of Sept 21. Tests run bi-weekly and require a physical or phone Student ID to enter.
  * TA Anika Annigeri requests email communications be sent to `anika.annigeri@ontariotechu.net` rather than Canvas inbox.
* **Linear Algebra (MATH-1850U)**:
  * Special Student Learning Centre row reduction review sessions running Sept 21 (10–11 AM online), Sept 22 (11 AM–12 PM in SHA361), and Sept 23 (10–11 AM online). Register via QuadC.
  * Week 2 Assessment grades are posted; Midterm #1 score will automatically replace this grade if higher.
* **Calculus I (MATH-1010U)**:
  * Calculus Readiness test results are viewable in the Mobius gradebook starting Mon, Sep 21 @ 8:00 AM.
  * Weekly updated schedule for prof/TA office hours is posted on Canvas every Sunday.
* **Campus & IT Updates**:
  * **MyOntarioTech Outage**: Full system outage scheduled from Fri, Sep 25 at 5:00 PM to Mon, Sep 28 at 8:00 AM.
  * **Google Gemini**: Enterprise version of Google Gemini AI is now available by logging in with university credentials.
  * **Health & Dental Plan**: Opt-out deadline is Wed, Sep 30.
  * **Mandatory Training**: Preventing Sexual Violence module on Canvas must be completed by Fri, Oct 9.

## Worth a Second Look
* **PHY-1010U Tutorial Schedule**: Check your personal weekly schedule on the Ontario Tech app to confirm if your bi-weekly tutorial test is scheduled for this week (Sept 21) or next week (Sept 28).
* **MATH-1850U MATLAB Prep**: Review the MATLAB Intro Guide/video under "Modules" in Canvas prior to attending your tutorial for In-Tutorial Assignment #2.
* **Engineering Comm. (46418) Tutorial Links**: Check MyOntarioTech for your assigned CRN to ensure you use the correct recurring Google Meet link sent in recent Canvas announcements.
* **ENGR-1015U Learning Tasks**: Complete the 3 asynchronous health and safety learning tasks in Canvas before attempting Quiz 1.
* **Ridgeback Academic Toolkit**: Contains an external link to a self-paced Canvas resource for university study skills and test preparation.
* **Email Fragment**: Email from Krishna Korambil (`pt. 2`) contains truncated text ("...orial this is our email aft... Wait for next email").
